# host_package_pacman (Data Source)

Reads Pacman package installation and sync-database metadata without managing the package.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "host_package_pacman" "git" {
  name = "git"
}

output "pacman_git_install_reason" {
  value = data.host_package_pacman.git.install_reason
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Pacman package name.

### Read-Only

- `candidate_version` (String) Latest package version from Pacman's sync databases. Null when no candidate is available.
- `id` (String) Package identifier, equal to `name`.
- `install_reason` (String) Observed Pacman install reason: `explicit` or `dependency`. Null when the package is not installed.
- `installed` (Boolean) Whether Pacman reports the package as installed.
- `installed_version` (String) Installed Pacman package version. Null when the package is not installed.
